title: In vivo OSKM reprogramming, teratoma formation, and cyclic dosing mitigation
book_use: Chapter 13; The Reprogramming Bet; Checked 2026-09-08; Supports: uncontrolled in-vivo reprogramming can produce teratomas and loss of cell identity; cyclic dosing can reduce severe failure modes in mouse models; Limits: Mouse-model safety evidence; does not establish a durable therapeutic window in humans.
